description: This file implements platform-specific DNS configuration watcher for macOS, including dynamic loading of system DNS info functions, and functions to monitor and check DNS configuration changes.

classes.name: DnsInfoApi
classes.description: Encapsulates dynamic loading of DNS configuration functions from system libraries on macOS.

classes.name: DnsConfigTDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for dns_config_t objects, calling the appropriate free function.

methods.name: GetDnsInfoApi
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DnsInfoApi with loaded system DNS functions.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::Watch
methods.description: Sets up a watcher to monitor DNS configuration changes.

methods.name: DnsConfigWatcher::CheckDnsConfig
methods.description: Checks current DNS configuration for unhandled options and resolvers.
